svg.title: Four dots make the cube
svg.text: One dot on the corner, one dot along each crease. The three faces are built from those four dots.
Put the white dot V on the room's corner point.
Turn each yellow guide line until it sits inside a crease.
Choose how far A, B and C reach along the creases.
Done. The faces share their edges with the real creases,
so they can never drift apart.
Each face is the four-sided shape between two arms.
For every projector pixel the shader asks: “where am I inside this
face?” (inverse bilinear interpolation), then paints that spot
